messages.subject: Project Lyra — engagement letter
messages.plaintextBody:
Patricia, Andrew,

Please find attached our engagement letter for the HSE investigation (our reference WC/CALV/LYRA). It sets out scope, the team, fees and — importantly — how we will handle privilege over the internal investigation materials.

Grateful if Patricia could countersign and return. We have already started given the time-sensitivity, and Tom attended site on 20 March.

Sarah

--
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Strictly private and confidential.
